lottie-teal.$description: Lottie Teal — Teal action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, headings, dark card surfaces, footer background, icon strokes — near-black with a barely-perceptible cool cast

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Dark card backgrounds, elevated dark surfaces, strong icon strokes, secondary dark UI blocks

slate-700.$description: Slate 700 — Dark muted surfaces and inverse muted backgrounds

steel.$description: Steel — Muted body text, secondary copy, icon fills, helper labels — sits between the primary ink and lighter grays

fog.$description: Fog — Subtle text, tertiary metadata, low-priority descriptions

cloud.$description: Cloud — Hairline borders, input outlines, subtle dividers between UI sections

mist.$description: Mist — Largest-volume border color across the UI; subtle separators, input borders, form outlines

warm-gray.$description: Warm Gray — Page canvas and soft card surfaces — the dominant background tone beneath white

paper.$description: Paper — Pure white surfaces: raised cards, button fills, content containers on top of warm-gray canvas

sunshine.$description: Sunshine — Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

mint-wash.$description: Mint Wash — Soft decorative fill in illustration/illustration-adjacent graphics

mint-pop.$description: Mint Pop — Bright decorative fill used in hero illustration characters and supporting graphics

ember.$description: Ember — Orange wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

dm-sans.$description: Display and heading family. Used for hero headlines (48–96px, weight 500), section headings (24–32px, weight 500), and large body (20px, weight 400). Letter-spacing tightens aggressively at large sizes — -0.0500em at 96px pulls characters into a compressed, poster-like composition that feels editorial rather than utilitarian. The medium weight (500) is the headline default, avoiding the heavy 700-800 convention used by most SaaS sites.

inter.$description: Utility and body family. Owns all body copy (16px), navigation (14px medium), buttons (14px medium), small labels (10–12px medium), and supporting icons. Consistent -0.0100em letter-spacing keeps it visually aligned to DM Sans at smaller sizes. Two-weight discipline (regular and medium only) keeps the interface feeling light and fast.
